title: An-Nazi'at as a whole: meaning and tadabbur: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nazi'at as a whole rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 35. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: Oaths and the Day: hearts tremble
The Hour: known only to Allah

panels.title: Tadabbur
points: Ask: what does Allah want me to do?

arabic.text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ (٤٠) فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ (٤١)

questions.q: In the portal response box, write one sentence on what 79:40 asks of you. Start: 'This ayah asks me to ...'
questions.a: For example: 'This ayah asks me to remember Allah and hold back from anger.'

questions.q: Reflection (Forms long answer): write a short paragraph on the main message of An-Nazi'at, using one ayah as evidence. Start: 'The main message is ...' Today's rota group recites 79:33 to 46.
questions.a: A paragraph with a clear message, one cited ayah and a personal link.

questions.q: Extend: find one ayah in An-Nazi'at that you will act on this week.
Stretch: compare An-Nazi'at's message with 'Abasa 80:33 to 42.
questions.a: Both describe the Day and the two groups; 'Abasa uses faces, An-Nazi'at uses refuges.

questions.q: Why is the story of Pharaoh in this surah?
options: As a warning to those who deny and transgress
questions.a: A) As a warning to those who deny and transgress. 79:26: 'Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].'

questions.q: Think again: If you had to sum up An-Nazi'at in one sentence, what would it be?
questions.a: The Day of Judgement is certain; those who fear Allah and hold back their desires will be in Paradise.
